opportunities.business: Empire Flippers #96416 — subscription iOS focus/sleep/wellness app
opportunities.description: Native iOS subscription app in the focus, sleep and wellness niche; monetizes recurring app subscriptions.
opportunities.age: First made money 2025; ~1 year track record
opportunities.ownerHours: 4 hrs/week seller-reported; very low if confirmed
opportunities.socialDependence: Very Low — no public evidence that daily founder social posting is core; verify acquisition mix in data room
opportunities.acquisitionChannels: App Store / subscription funnel; exact paid-organic mix not publicly disclosed and must be verified
opportunities.retention: Recurring subscription; churn/cohort data not public
opportunities.customerConcentration: Not publicly disclosed; request subscriber concentration/cohorts
opportunities.dependencies: Apple App Store concentration; subscription transfer; code/IP; content/API licensing; short operating history
opportunities.dueDiligenceConfidence: 8/10 — live listing, price/revenue/profit/workload cross-checked; retention and acquisition mix remain private
opportunities.redFlags: Only ~1 year old; recent growth may not be normalized; App Store/platform risk; churn and paid CAC unknown
opportunities.fit: Best current mix of low workload, recurring digital revenue, 18x price and a product a technical owner can improve without creator-led marketing
opportunities.recommendation: BUY IF VERIFIED. Seek holdback/earnout for retention and App Store continuity; avoid paying above current ask until cohorts and CAC are verified.
opportunities.plan90: Days 1-30 reconcile App Store/Stripe and cohorts, audit code/IP/security, freeze risky changes; 31-60 automate support/onboarding and test lifecycle email/paid search; 61-90 ship highest-ROI retention/pricing feature and reduce platform concentration.

opportunities.socialDependence: Very Low — demand appears search/intent-led rather than creator-led; verify exact SEO/PPC split
opportunities.acquisitionChannels: Likely high-intent SEO/domain portfolio plus direct digital conversion; exact mix private
opportunities.retention: Digital-product/SaaS mix; recurring share and churn not publicly disclosed
opportunities.customerConcentration: Not public; request order/subscriber concentration and state mix
opportunities.dependencies: US legal/regulatory changes; SEO/domain concentration; traffic decline; state-by-state product maintenance
opportunities.dueDiligenceConfidence: 8/10 — live listing and workload/financials cross-checked; detailed channel/retention/legal data gated
opportunities.redFlags: Traffic down 28% and revenue down 11%; legal/regulatory maintenance; verify no fragile SEO/domain dependency
opportunities.fit: Exceptionally low reported workload, mature track record, high margin and attractive 24x price; technical/process automation is a strong owner fit
opportunities.recommendation: BUY IF VERIFIED / NEGOTIATE. Prefer 21–23x monthly SDE unless traffic decline has clearly stabilized and legal/SEO diligence is clean.
opportunities.plan90: Days 1-30 reconcile sales/traffic by domain/state and legal review; 31-60 consolidate analytics/support and improve conversion/lifecycle; 61-90 refresh highest-value state flows, diversify SEO with paid search/partnership tests, document compliance updates.

opportunities.business: Empire Flippers #91705 — AI sales automation SaaS
opportunities.description: B2B SaaS that qualifies leads and books appointments through WhatsApp and Instagram DMs, replacing manual appointment setters.
opportunities.socialDependence: Low — product works on social messaging platforms but customer acquisition is not shown to require owner posting; verify seller channel mix
opportunities.acquisitionChannels: B2B/product-led and likely paid/partner channels; exact mix private. Product itself depends on WhatsApp/Instagram APIs.
opportunities.retention: Recurring/usage-based SaaS; recent public reporting cites ~5% churn, CAC ~€100, LTV ~€2,171
opportunities.customerConcentration: International customer base; exact top-customer concentration private
opportunities.dependencies: Meta WhatsApp/Instagram API policy, pricing and account-ban risk; AI model/API costs; data/privacy obligations
opportunities.dueDiligenceConfidence: 8/10 — live listing plus financial/workload and unit-economics reporting cross-checked; customer/channel detail remains private
opportunities.redFlags: Core functionality sits on third-party messaging APIs; only ~2-year history; confirm churn definition and gross margin after API/AI costs
opportunities.fit: Very high margins, low owner time, recurring B2B revenue and a codebase/product a software engineer can operate and improve
opportunities.recommendation: BUY IF VERIFIED. Target 26–28x or structure holdback tied to 6–12 months of retention and continued Meta API access.
opportunities.plan90: Days 1-30 audit APIs, cohorts, CAC/LTV, code/security and support; 31-60 add monitoring, onboarding/lifecycle and API-failure fallbacks; 61-90 improve pricing/usage tiers, integrations and partner/outbound acquisition rather than organic posting.

opportunities.business: Empire Flippers #88253 — niche European-language learning SaaS
opportunities.description: Duolingo-style subscription language-learning platform focused on an underserved European language with limited mainstream-platform coverage.
opportunities.socialDependence: Very Low — prior seller disclosure emphasized strong organic search and minimal CAC, not founder-led social
opportunities.acquisitionChannels: Primarily organic search/brand; historically minimal CAC; verify current source percentages and keyword concentration
opportunities.retention: ~800 active subscribers previously disclosed; >12-month average subscription duration; ~6% realized monthly churn
opportunities.customerConcentration: B2C subscriber base; exact concentration not meaningful/public; geographic/language niche concentration is high
opportunities.dependencies: Single-language niche ceiling; SEO concentration; content/IP quality; app/web platform maintenance
opportunities.dueDiligenceConfidence: 8/10 — live current listing and prior detailed seller disclosures; current cohort/channel details should be refreshed
opportunities.redFlags: 43x valuation is expensive for 6% growth; niche TAM concentration; verify organic rankings and churn cohorts
opportunities.fit: Possibly the most passive asset in the set: 2 hrs/week, recurring subscriptions, ~97% margin and long track record with search-led acquisition
opportunities.recommendation: NEGOTIATE. Attractive nearer 32–35x monthly SDE; pay 43x only if retention, SEO moat and low workload are exceptionally well verified.
opportunities.plan90: Days 1-30 verify churn/cohorts, rankings, content/IP and code; 31-60 improve onboarding/retention and email lifecycle; 61-90 test pricing/annual plans, SEO expansion and partnerships for adjacent learner audiences.
